infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: PocketSage uses your calendar to answer schedule questions and create events.
infoPlist.NSRemindersUsageDescription: PocketSage uses reminders to set and manage your to-do items.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: PocketSage uses contacts to look up people you mention.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: PocketSage reads health data to answer wellness questions.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: PocketSage can write health data when you ask it to log workouts or meals.
